description: Plain single-line text field. The simplest Field shape: no per-type extra keys beyond the universal ones every Field must carry.
notes: Model (back-ref to the owning root/table Model) and CreatedAt are mandatory on EVERY Field of every type; the API accepts a write missing them (200, publishes clean) but the builder then fails to render the whole flow. This is the single most common way to build something that lies about working.

Column points at this field's own Column node (Type:Field) — see row_grid.json / section.json for how that Column is wired into a Row/Section; this file deliberately stays minimal to teach the Field node in isolation.
Node id casing is capitalised on the wire: Field_, Column_, Row_, not field_/column_/row_.
